statement: Pinned software and WiiBrew single-MP documentation do not establish mechanical safety or power/address arbitration for two MP modules, whether Plus bypasses or accepts external MP, which sensor answers a register request, or whether a second gyro stream is physically possible. All are deferred #52 E1/E2/E3 questions with no physical hardware observations.

applicability.revision: Physical Plus with extra MP and two nested external MPs
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer. #52 physical arms not run; ordinary WiiBrew single-MP pass-through is not a dual-MP result.
